I've saved a daily job that posts "North morning digest" in #north-team at 09:15 (UTC-5). It covers the previous day in #north-team and #inc-qfl-sev1. Everyone in #north-team is also in the incident room, so nothing in the digest is new to them. It leaves out finance figures.

The job won't fire yet because the scheduler (the Hermes gateway) isn't running on my side. Until someone starts it, tomorrow's digest won't post. I said the same in #north-team.

The job runs on UTC time, so it's set to 14:15 UTC. If the company clock moves off UTC-5, for example at a daylight-saving change, the post time will shift with it. I haven't tested a run.
